content: Isa Zeruzalem goler
Hitara zẽtte Zeruzalemor hãsa hãsi oiye edde Zaitun faharor ḍake Betfage edde Betaniya farar hãse aišše, Isaye duizon sahabire
endilla hoi defeṛaiye,

content.text: "Oi sarmor farat zo, heṛe goli mottor ek gadar so banda dekiba, zibar uwore ehon o hono manuše no boiye. Hiba kuli ãlla loi anogoi.
Ar zodi honokiye fusar gore, 'Tũwara hendilla kiyolla goror?' toile hoiba, 'Ibare Malikottu dorhar oiye edde ibare uwafes toratori eṛe firai dibo.'"

content: Toi hitara giye edde gadar soware rastat ekkan dorozar ḍake banda faiye. Hitara hibare kuille.
Henot heṛe zara tiyai aššilde hitara hodde, "Tũwara ki goror? Gadar sowa kiyolla kulor?"
Isaye zendilla hoito hoil hitara hendilla hoiye, toi hitarare ejazot diye.
Tarfore hitara gadar soware Isar hãse ainne edde hibar uwore hitarar saddor bisai diye, toi hibar uwore Isa boišše.
Bout mainše hibare šorman goribolla hoi hitarar saddor okkolore rastar uwore bisai diye, ar kiye maṛottu fatawala ḍeila okkol ani fõtot šiṛi diye.
Ar ze manuš okkol age edde fise gil hitara guzojje,

content.text: "Ãrar Baf Daudor ze raijjo aiyer, hiba rahamoti."

content: Bade Isa Zeruzalemot goliyore butore dórmogóror uṛanot giye. Hibaye sairo mikkar hár kissur uzu saiye, tarfore beil giyegoi boli he barozon sahabire fũwati loi Betaniyat giyegoi.
Gula sara ḍũir gas
Tarfor din, hitara Betaniya sari zargoide šomot, Isattu bug laigge.
Hibaye durottu ugguwa fatawala ḍũir gas deikke edde hibat hono gula asene nai saito giye. Kintu hiba heṛe zaiyore fata bade ar kissu no fa, kiyollahoile hẽtte ḍũir gula dorede ainda no.
Toi hibaye gassware hodde,

content.text: "Ar hono din honokiye tottu gula no háibo."

content: Ar ei hota hibaye hodde hibar sahabi okkole fuinne.
Dórmogór munazator zaga

Bade hitara Zeruzalem aišše, ar Isa uwore dórmogóror uṛanot góille edde heṛe zara besa kina goijjil hitarare hentu lorai diya šuru goijje. Hibaye ṭiya bodolidoya okkolor ṭebil edde hoitor besoya okkolor ṭebil uldai diye.
Ar hibaye dórmogóror uṛan bai honokiyore hono besa kinar ziniš boi loizaito no de.
Bade hibaye šikka diye,

content.text: "Iyan endilla leka nai ne?, 'Ãr górore hár zatilla munazator gór ḍaka oibo'? Kintu tũwara iyanore ḍahaitor aḍḍahana banaifelaiyo!"

content: Ḍõr imam edde alem okkole ei hota fuinne edde hitara hibare marifelaibolla rasta tuwa šuru goijje. Hitara hibare ḍoraito, kiyollahoile manuš okkol hibar šikkat tajjuf oi zaitogoi.
Ar hazinna oile Isa edde hibar sahabi okkol šohoror baire zaitogoi.
Biššaš edde duwa
Toi hitara binna zadde ṭaimot dekedde ḍũir gasswa šiyorottu loti fuwai giyegoi.
Fitorottu Isar hota monot foijje edde hodde, "Ustad, so, ze ḍũir gasore õne bodduwa dila hiba fuwai giyegoi."
Hetunot Isaye hitarare zuwabe hodde,

content.text: Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, zodi honokiye ei faharore ho, 'Uṛiyore doriyat zai for,' ar hitar dile šondo no gore kintu hite ziyan hoiye hiyan oibode biššaš gore, iyan hitalla gora oibo.
Hetolla ãi tũwarare hoir, tũwarar munazatot ze hono kissu so, biššaš goro ze tũwara hin faifelaiyo, ar hin tũwarar oibo.
Ar tũwara zẽtte munazat goitto tiyo, honokiyor berudde hono kissu take, toile hitare maf goro, zene tũwarar behostor Bafe o tũwarar guna maf gori fare."
(Kintu tũwara zodi maf no goro, toile tũwarare o tũwarar behostor Bafe tũwarar guna maf no goribo.)

content: Isar kemotar babute suwal
Hitara abar Zeruzalemot aišše edde dórmogóror uṛanot Isaye gura fira gorer, ḍõr imam okkol, he alem okkol edde bura murobbi okkol hibar hãse aišše,
edde hitara hibare hodde, "Har kemota loi tui in okkol goros? Otóba in goribolla ei kemota tore hone diye?"
Toi zuwabe Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi o tũwarare ekkan hota suwal gori, ãre hiyanor zuwab do, toi ãi o tũwarare hoiyum har kemota loi ãi in okkol gori.
Yahyar torikotor gusol, iyan ki Allattu naki mainšottu?"

content: Toi hitara ekzone ekzon loi mošora gori hodde, "Zodi hoi, 'Allaro torfottu,' hen oile hite hoibo, 'Toile tũwara Yahyare biššaš ka no goro?'
Naki endilla zuwab diyum, 'Mainšor torfottu?'" (Kintu hitara mainšore ḍoraiye, kiyollahoile beggune Yahyare ekzon soiyi nobi boli mainto.)
Toi hitara Isare zuwab diye, "Ãra no zani." Hetunot Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Toile ãi o tũwarare no hoiyum har kemota loi ãi in okkol gori."
